第十七章 万圣节舞会
叶锋盖帽、助攻科比绝杀成为了当天的最佳进球，他一夜间成为了洛杉矶的名人。
第二天训练时，美女球探拉芙林找到了叶锋，笑问道：“嗨，叶，你晚上有空吗？我有位朋友希望你能做她的舞伴参加万圣节舞会。她和是你在UCLA是校友，你会喜欢她的。”
叶锋笑道：“有空，是化妆舞会吧？我恐怕没有服装。”
“她会为你准备，训练结束后，她来接你。”
万圣节时间为每年的11月1日，源自古代塞尔特民族的新年节庆，此时也是祭祀亡魂的时刻，在避免恶灵干扰的同时，也以食物祭拜祖灵及善灵以祈平安渡过严冬，是西方传统节日。除了化妆舞会，小孩还会穿上化妆服，戴上面具，挨家挨户收集糖果。万圣节主要流行于不列颠群岛和北美，其次是澳大利亚和新西兰。
今天节日气息很农，一切关于万圣节的商品随处可见，居民的住宅外摆放了很多的恐怖摆设已达到吓人的效果，譬如摆放僵尸、骷髅、女巫等，当然还有南瓜。
化妆舞会美国最有意思的舞会之一，叶锋很有兴趣。今天晚上他的公寓也会办一个小型派对，还是USC的学生为主。不能和加布瑞拉一起过节有点遗憾，但两人只是单纯的室友，有不恋爱的协定，加布瑞拉会尊重他的决定。拉芙林是名人，邀请他参加的聚会肯定会很上档次，他也不想错过认识洛杉矶名人的机会。
拉芙林介绍的女孩儿不是外人，是湖人太子爷约翰尼.巴斯的独生女妮娜.巴斯。这位含着金钥匙长大的小公主和叶锋同校。
叶锋对约翰尼倒是很熟悉，前世他干狗仔队的时候，曾曝过约翰尼的料，湖人太子爷生活很不检点，每年都在妓院开千人生日宴会，那家妓院是美国内华达州最知名的合法妓院。叶锋只希望妮娜不像他老爹这样胡来。
训练结束后，叶锋在球馆里冲了个澡，很快接到了妮娜的电话。不一会儿，妮娜开了一辆樱桃色的法拉利跑车到了球馆。她穿了身漂亮的黑衣，脸上有一道纤细的血红疤痕，说是扮成“血腥玛丽”。
“原来镜子巫婆这么漂亮，怪不得这么多人喜欢召唤她。”叶锋笑道。妮娜真的很漂亮，皮肤细嫩，一双大眼睛好似会说话一般。巴斯家族有漂亮的基因，和杰克逊谈恋爱的珍妮，40岁了都很漂亮。看到妮娜后，他松了口气，万一老板的孙女很丑，去舞会可就郁闷了。
“谢谢。看看我给你准备的衣服吧。”妮娜笑着把一套服装从后备箱里拿出来，交给了叶锋。叶锋一眼就认出了那套衣服，竟然是吸血鬼猎人范海辛。别人都是扮鬼，他扮成猎人去，太显眼了吧？
妮娜找了最大的尺寸，叶锋把衣服穿起来很合身，他带上假发和帽子从更衣室走出来，妮娜拍手叫好，唯一美中不足的是叶锋太年轻，没有休杰克曼那种沧桑感。
上了高档的法拉利跑车，叶锋有点紧张，好像一下子进入了上层社会。他笑问道：“我被雷劈后到现在都还没恢复记忆，妮娜，我们以前认识吗？”
妮娜微笑道：“你果然是失忆了，我比你高一年级，只说过一次话，那天我和前男友吵架，他想要动手打我，你刚好路过，狠狠的揍了他，以后他看到你就躲。虽然学校里的人都觉得你危险，但我想你是很有正义感的一个人。你现在变化好大，以前你很酷，现在却很爱笑，我喜欢你现在的样子，以前我都不敢找你说话。”
以前这家伙没有被抓进监狱真是奇迹，叶锋笑道：“我不会再变回以前那样了。”
生在巴斯家族，妮娜对篮球也很感兴趣，她认为叶锋加盟湖人是一种缘分，于是邀请他参加舞会。女人是感性动物，对男人产生好感的理由往往非常简单，她们会喜欢上野蛮的男人，有时只为对方一个动作，一句话。叶锋的粗暴给他留下了深刻的印象。
法拉利驶入一座庄园别墅，叶锋惊讶的发现这个地方自己前世来过，为了拍摄明星万圣节化妆的照片，他和朋友一起潜入了这里，而且就是今天。
别墅的主人名叫艾莉儿.斯特林，是快船队老板唐纳德.斯特林的小女儿。在他前世，这场舞会上发生了暴力伤人事件，艾莉儿把自己的朋友玛莎推下了楼梯使其三处骨折，因此受到了指控。不久媒体又爆出了艾莉儿是同性恋的消息。斯特林是NBA老板中有名的异类，他的女儿也不是省油的灯。

据说艾莉儿不喜欢男人是父亲私生活不检点造成的，唐纳德曾因性骚扰被告上法庭，还包养年轻妓女被艾莉儿撞见，这对她的人生观产生了影响。
叶锋很怀疑这种说法，进入21世纪后，美国女同性恋已经发展成为一种时尚，尤其是20岁左右的女孩，很多人都想尝试一下。在美国国家健康统计工作中心对女性同性恋问题进行调查时，很多女人都愿意承认自己是同性恋者，她们并不为此而感到难以启齿。
居然来了这里？时空不会因此而错乱吧？叶锋紧张的搓着手，他不知道那次坠楼事件还会不会发生，会不会遇到前世的自己，遇过遇到就太神奇了。
妮娜降低了车速，问道：“你表情怎么这么严肃？坐车不舒服吗？”
叶锋苦笑道：“这里不是斯特林家的豪宅吗？身为湖人球员，到快船的地盘感觉有点怪。”
妮娜笑道：“你知道这里啊？不用想那么多，我们两家人联系一直很密切，当年还是我爷爷建议斯特林先生经营快船的呢。”
叶锋点了点头，他当然知道两家人联系密切。
前世他无法靠近别墅，只能躲在树上，透过窗口偷拍，这次却是光明正大的从正门走入。妮娜出示了金色的请帖，轻轻的揽着他的胳膊进了大厅，侍者们很有风度的像他们行了礼。
屋里已经有不少人，造型个性，但又不失华丽，给人群魔乱舞的感觉。这样的名人聚会叶锋还是第一次参加，进门后他就不住的窗口看，原来他就是躲在那里拍照，他并没有看到自己，也许这是一个平行世界，林如意并不存在。
叶锋身材高大魁梧，配上范海辛的服装，气质不凡，在一群有钱人中间，他却很快成为了场内的焦点。妮娜向很多朋友介绍了叶锋，这些有钱人都没什么架子，和他围绕篮球聊了一些轻松的话题。和这些人聊天，叶锋也不拘谨，偶尔说几句笑话，开个小玩笑。他还认识了一位自己喜欢的电影明星——亚当.桑德勒！桑德勒是老球迷，特别喜欢结交球星朋友，两人一见如故，聊了半个钟头。桑德勒笑言如果早认识他，一定请他客串出演自己的电影《最长的一码》。
随便吃了些东西，舞会开始了。叶锋很久没有跳舞，幸好动作还记得很清楚，没有出丑。两支舞过后，有些男士来邀请妮娜跳自由舞，叶锋拿了杯饮料，独自到一边小坐。他一直关注视着二楼楼梯，当一身男装的艾莉儿出现在楼梯口时，他知道那件事还是要发生的。
既然知道未来，就别让那位小姐滚下楼梯了吧，摔成骨折可够悲惨的。叶锋假装漫不经心的踱步到楼梯口，看到两位女子发生争执时，他马上风一般冲上了楼梯，正好赶上那名叫玛莎的女子被推下楼……叶锋身子微微一倾，将那名女子揽在了怀里，稳稳的站住，他的力量很强，抗冲击，换成普通人，可能就要一起滚下楼去了。
玛莎吓的脸色苍白，她以为自己肯定要摔下楼梯，没想到竟被人接住。艾莉儿也很惊讶，全场只有她看到了叶锋速度有多快，一瞬间就冲上来了，简直就像功夫片。
叶锋把玛莎身体扶正，轻声问道：“小姐你没事吧？”
“我没事，谢谢。艾莉尔你……”玛莎道谢后，怨恨的瞪着艾莉儿，却没有把话说下去。
叶锋摸着帽檐，隐蔽的朝艾莉尔使了个眼色，示意她说些什么。艾莉儿马上换了副笑脸，变脸比翻书还快，大声对楼下的宾客们说：“她刚刚绊了一跤，幸好被这位先生扶住了。没事了，大家继续玩。”
艾莉儿轻描淡写的就将把人推下楼说成了对方自己绊了一跤，没有引起怀疑。
玛莎脸色难看，咬了咬牙，冷道：“艾莉儿，我们完了。”说完扶着楼梯扶手慢慢下了楼。
艾莉尔叹了口气，坐在了二楼的沙发椅上。叶锋走了过去，叹道：“你这么做太冲动，这么瘦弱的姑娘滚下去摔成骨折，你会被起诉的。”
艾莉尔微微一笑：“你都看见了？谢谢你帮我，饿狼。”

艾莉儿称呼了叶锋的外号，叶锋打量着她，更觉她的笑容很爷们，她肯定是百合中扮演男性的一方，和这样的女人说话，挺有意思的。

Chapter 17 Halloween Party
Ye Feng blocked a shot and assisted Kobe Bryant's buzzer-beater, which became the best goal of the day. He became a celebrity in Los Angeles overnight.
During training the next day, beautiful scout Laughlin found Ye Feng and asked with a smile: "Hi, Ye, are you free tonight? I have a friend who wants you to be her dance partner for the Halloween dance. She and you are alumni at UCLA, and you will like her."
Ye Feng smiled and said: "I have time, is it a masquerade party? I'm afraid I don't have a costume."
"She will prepare it for you, and after training, she will pick you up."
Halloween is held on November 1st every year. It originated from the New Year festival of the ancient Celtic people. It is also a time to worship the souls of the dead. While avoiding the interference of evil spirits, people also use food to worship ancestors and good spirits to pray for a safe passage through the harsh winter. It is a traditional Western festival. In addition to the masquerade party, children will also put on costumes and masks and go door to door to collect candies. Halloween is mainly popular in the British Isles and North America, followed by Australia and New Zealand.
The holiday atmosphere is very festive today, and all Halloween-related products can be seen everywhere. Residents have placed a lot of scary decorations outside their homes to achieve a scary effect, such as zombies, skeletons, witches, etc., and of course pumpkins.
Masquerade is one of the most interesting dances in the United States, and Ye Feng is very interested in it. There will also be a small party held in his apartment tonight, mainly for USC students. It's a pity that he can't spend the holidays with Gabriella, but the two of them are just roommates and have an agreement not to fall in love. Gabriella will respect his decision. Laughlin is a celebrity, so any party he's invited to will definitely be classy, ​​and he doesn't want to miss the opportunity to meet celebrities in Los Angeles.
The girl Laughlin introduced was no outsider, she was Nina Buss, the only daughter of Lakers prince Johnny Buss. This little princess who grew up with a golden key in her mouth was in the same school as Ye Feng.
Ye Feng was very familiar with Johnny. In his previous life, when he was working as a paparazzi, he had exposed information about Johnny. The Prince of Lakers lived a very disorderly life and held a birthday party for thousands of people every year at a brothel. That brothel was the most famous legal brothel in Nevada, USA. Ye Feng just hoped that Nina wouldn't act like his father.
After training, Ye Feng took a shower in the gym and soon received a call from Nina. After a while, Nina drove a cherry-colored Ferrari sports car to the arena. She was wearing beautiful black clothes and had a thin blood-red scar on her face. She said she was dressed as "Bloody Mary."
"It turns out that the Mirror Witch is so beautiful, no wonder so many people like to summon her." Ye Feng said with a smile. Nina is really beautiful, with delicate skin and big eyes that seem to be able to talk. The Bass family has beautiful genes, and Jenny, who is in love with Jackson, is very beautiful even at the age of 40. After seeing Nina, he breathed a sigh of relief. If the boss's granddaughter was ugly, going to the prom would be depressing.
"Thank you. Take a look at the clothes I prepared for you." Nina smiled and took out a set of clothes from the trunk and handed it to Ye Feng. Ye Feng recognized the suit at a glance. It turned out to be vampire hunter Van Helsing. Everyone else is pretending to be ghosts, but he pretends to be a hunter. Isn't it too conspicuous?
Nina found the largest size, and Ye Feng put on the clothes that fit him perfectly. He put on a wig and a hat and walked out of the dressing room. Nina clapped her hands and applauded. The only flaw was that Ye Feng was too young and did not have the vicissitudes of life like Hugh Jackman.
Ye Feng was a little nervous after getting into the high-end Ferrari sports car, as if he had suddenly entered the upper class society. He smiled and asked: "I still haven't recovered my memory after being struck by lightning. Nina, have we known each other before?"
Nina smiled and said: "You have indeed lost your memory. I am a grade above you and we only talked once. I had an argument with my ex-boyfriend that day and he wanted to hit me. You happened to pass by and beat him up hard. He will hide when he sees you in the future. Although everyone in the school thinks you are dangerous, I thinkYou are a person with a great sense of justice. You have changed so much now. You used to be cool, but now you love to laugh. I like the way you are now. I didn’t dare to talk to you before. "
It’s a miracle that this guy wasn’t caught in jail before, Ye Feng said with a smile: “I won’t go back to the way I was before. "
Born in the Bass family, Nina was also very interested in basketball. She thought it was fate for Ye Feng to join the Lakers, so she invited him to the dance. Women are emotional creatures, and the reason for their attraction to men is often very simple. They will fall in love with a savage man, sometimes just for a single action or a word from him. Ye Feng's rudeness left a deep impression on him.
The Ferrari drove into a manor villa. Ye Feng was surprised to find that he had been to this place in his previous life. In order to take photos of celebrities wearing Halloween makeup, he and his friends sneaked in here, and it was today.
The owner of the villa is Ariel Sterling, the youngest daughter of Clippers owner Donald Sterling. In his previous life, a violent incident occurred at this dance. Ariel pushed his friend Martha down the stairs and broke her body in three places, resulting in charges. Soon the media broke the news that Ariel was gay. Sterling is a well-known outlier among NBA owners, and his daughter is not a fuel-efficient lamp either.
It is said that Ariel's dislike of men was caused by her father's indecent private life. Donald was once sued in court for sexual harassment, and he also kept a young prostitute and was caught by Ariel, which had an impact on her outlook on life.
Ye Feng is very skeptical of this statement. After entering the 21st century, lesbianism in the United States has developed into a fashion, especially for girls in their 20s. Many people want to try it. When the National Center for Health Statistics conducted a survey on female homosexuality, many women were willing to admit that they were homosexual, and they did not feel embarrassed about it.
Actually came here? Time and space won't be messed up because of this, right? Ye Feng rubbed his hands nervously. He didn't know if that falling incident would happen again, or if he would meet himself in his previous life. It would be amazing if he did.
Nina slowed down the car and asked, "Why are you looking so serious? Is it uncomfortable to ride in the car? "
Ye Feng smiled bitterly and said: "Isn't this the Sterling family's mansion? As a Laker, it feels a little weird to be on Clippers territory. "
Nina smiled and said: "You know this place? Don’t think too much, our two families have always been very close. It was my grandfather who suggested Mr. Sterling run the Clippers back then. "
Ye Feng nodded. Of course he knew that the two families were closely connected.
In his previous life, he couldn't get close to the villa, so he could only hide in the trees and take secret photos through the window. This time, he walked in through the front door openly. Nina showed the golden invitation and gently took his arm into the hall. The waiters bowed to them gracefully.
There are already many people in the room. The style is unique but still gorgeous, giving the crowd the feeling of dancing wildly. This was the first time for Ye Feng to attend such a celebrity gathering. After entering, he looked out the window where he lived. It turned out that he was hiding there to take pictures. He did not see himself. Maybe this was a parallel world and Lin Ruyi did not exist.
Ye Feng is tall and burly, and with Van Helsing's clothes, he has an extraordinary temperament. Among a group of wealthy people, he quickly became the focus of the field. Nina introduced Ye Feng to many of her friends. These rich people had no airs and chatted with him about some relaxed topics around basketball. When chatting with these people, Ye Feng was not restrained and occasionally told a few jokes and made small jokes. He also met one of his favorite movie stars—Adam Sandler! Sandler is an old football fan and especially likes to make friends with star players. The two hit it off and chatted for half an hour. Sandler joked that if he had known him earlier, he would have asked him to guest star in his movie "The Longest Yard."
After eating something casually, the dance party began. leavesFeng hadn't danced for a long time, but fortunately he still remembered the moves clearly and didn't make a fool of himself. After two dances, some men came to invite Nina for a free dance. Ye Feng took a drink and sat aside alone. He kept paying attention to the stairs on the second floor. When Ariel, dressed in men's clothing, appeared at the top of the stairs, he knew that it was still going to happen.
Now that you know the future, don't let that lady roll down the stairs. It would be tragic enough to break a bone. Ye Feng pretended to be casual and walked to the stairs. When he saw the two women arguing, he immediately rushed up the stairs, just in time to catch up with the woman named Martha being pushed downstairs... Ye Feng leaned slightly, held the woman in his arms, and stood firmly. He was very strong and resistant to impact. If it were an ordinary person, they might have rolled downstairs together.
Martha turned pale with fright. She thought she was going to fall down the stairs, but she didn't expect to be caught by someone. Ariel was also surprised. She was the only one in the audience who saw how fast Ye Feng was. He rushed up in an instant, just like a kung fu movie.
Ye Feng straightened Martha's body and asked softly: "Miss, are you okay?"
"I'm fine, thank you. Ariel, you..." After Martha thanked her, she glared at Ariel resentfully, but did not finish her words.
Ye Feng touched the brim of his hat and winked at Ariel secretly, signaling her to say something. Ariel immediately changed her smile, her face changed faster than flipping through a book, and loudly said to the guests downstairs: "She just tripped, but luckily she was held by this gentleman. It's okay, let's continue playing."
Ariel casually explained that pushing the person down the stairs was because the other person tripped, without arousing suspicion.
Martha looked ugly, gritted her teeth, and said coldly: "Ariel, we're done." After saying that, she held on to the handrail of the stairs and slowly went downstairs.
Ariel sighed and sat on the sofa chair on the second floor. Ye Feng walked over and sighed: "You are too impulsive to do this. Such a thin girl will fall and break her bones. You will be prosecuted."
Ariel smiled slightly: "Did you see it all? Thank you for helping me, hungry wolf."
Ariel called Ye Feng by her nickname. Ye Feng looked at her and thought her smile was very manly. She must be the male character in Lily. It was quite interesting to talk to such a woman.
